name: Sorbonne Université
summary: Paris research university for arts, medicine and science; its bachelor's degrees are taught in French, and first year asks for B2 French.

ib.text: The IB is accepted; EU/EEA nationals apply through Parcoursup. First-year courses are taught in French in every faculty, and B2 French is required.

lastYear.text: wishes 19 January–12 March; confirm by 1 April

notes: Sorbonne's English-taught programmes are all master's; its own page says no undergraduate degrees are offered in English.
The 2027 Parcoursup calendar is not out yet; in 2026 wishes closed on 12 March and files had to be confirmed by 1 April.
